guitar.modelsText: Hamer / Parker Fly / Gibson Les Paul
guitar.notes: Vernon Reid is a well-known and technically distinctive guitarist (also associated with Parker Fly guitars), though no single guitar is as iconic as top-tier examples, so medium confidence.

tone.target: bright high-gain rock with wah lead edge and slight chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright high-gain rock with wah lead edge and slight chorus sheen
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a Boost for initial punch, followed by Distortion for aggressive gain, an AC30 TB amp model for classic bite, a Wah pedal for lead work, Chorus for sheen, and a 4x12 cab to ground the sound.
corrections: add wah as decisive lead texture

rig.name: Living Colour - Cult Of Personality - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum.
Add initial punch and tighten the low end for palm-muted riffs.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD/Green OD to maintain clarity while adding necessary aggression.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core high-gain rock crunch and mid-forward bite.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is chosen for its aggressive, punchy hard rock character, avoiding overly scooped modern metal tones.

blocks.purpose: Deliver the decisive lead texture and characteristic wah sweeps.
Simulate the bright, mid-forward bite of a Marshall/AC30 style amp.
blocks.gap: The AC30 TB is ideal for classic rock brightness and punchy mids.

blocks.purpose: Add the required subtle 'chorus sheen' to lead lines without washing out the tone.
Ground the high-gain sound with a classic British cabinet tone.
Add subtle depth and space to the lead phrases.
blocks.gap: Avoided washiness by keeping feedback low and time moderate.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space without muddying the aggressive tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall punch by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive British 4x12.

proposals.reason: Enhance punch and mid-forward bite for classic rock feel.
